craft_notes: Sthāyin: twelve-end refrain (v28's word returns). Rows: row 3 (firm-minded→mark proceeds). Close: proceeds (pravartate — the mark now moves outward). Rejected: 'bīja' for lakṣya — killed: reality-mark kept; 'manifestation' — killed: proceeds kept (motion verb).

lines: From all around own body, twelve-end, mind-dissolving:
firm-minded made firm — the reality-mark proceeds.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvataḥ svaśarīrasya dvādaśānte manolayāt | dṛḍhabuddher dṛḍhībhūtaṃ tattvalakṣyam pravartate

reads_against.argmap: What becomes firm? → Mind-dissolving at the twelve-end sets the reality-mark firm.
